body.name: Deterministically selected chartwise Wald procedure
body.construction: Set \(t_n=n^{-1/4}\) and compute the lexicographic certified-rigid selector \(\widehat\chi_n\), using \(\bot\) if no chart qualifies. Set \(\widehat\tau_n=F_{\widehat\chi_n}(\widehat\zeta_n)\). If \(\widehat\gamma_n=1\), report the sandwich covariance and its Wald ellipse; if \(\widehat\gamma_n=0\), set \(\widehat V_n=I_2\) and report \(W_n=[0,1]^2\).
